clarityshader.configuration.title: Clarity Shader
clarityshader.config.profile.tooltip: Low: color grading, haze and simple water. Medium: adds reflections, bloom, ambient occlusion, god rays and sun shadows. High/Max: more samples and longer, sharper shadows. Custom: pick every effect yourself.
clarityshader.config.auto_target_fps.too: Frame rate the Auto profile aims for. It measures your FPS while you play, lowers effects and render scale when you drop below it and raises them again while it holds. Minecraft's own frame rate limit counts as the target when it is lower.
clarityshader.config.distant_horizons.to: Draw Distant Horizons' far-away terrain. Off turns DH's rendering off; its own setting comes back when you turn this on again.
clarityshader.config.distant_horizons_as: Ask at every game start whether to draw Distant Horizons this time.
clarityshader.prompt.distant_horizons.me: Draw Distant Horizons' far-away terrain this session? You can change this later in Clarity Shader's settings.
clarityshader.config.distant_horizons_sh: Also apply the haze, sunset silhouettes and colour grading to Distant Horizons' far-away terrain. Off leaves it exactly as DH draws it, with the effects fading out towards the render distance.
clarityshader.config.custom.tooltip: Per-effect quality, used when the profile is Custom.
clarityshader.config.ambient_occlusion.t: Soft shadows in corners and under blocks.
clarityshader.config.reflections.tooltip: Low reflects only the sky and sun; Medium and up also reflect terrain on screen.
clarityshader.config.god_rays.tooltip: Light shafts from the sun through trees and terrain.
clarityshader.config.shadows.tooltip: Shadows cast by terrain, trees and buildings, also from off screen. High and up add fine contact shadows.
clarityshader.config.look.tooltip: Image adjustments applied on every profile.
clarityshader.config.warmth.tooltip: Golden tint at sunrise/sunset and cool tint at night.
clarityshader.config.atmosphere.tooltip: Strength of the sunlit haze over distant terrain.
clarityshader.config.weather_integration: With WeatherStory installed, clouds and storms dim god rays, glare and sun reflections. With Sodium, WeatherStory's cloud shadows are drawn on the terrain as part of the sun shadows.
clarityshader.config.upscaling.tooltip: Render the world at a lower resolution and upscale it with AMD FSR 1. Set per profile; the HUD and hand always stay sharp.
clarityshader.config.render_scale.toolti: Resolution the world is rendered at for this profile before AMD FSR 1 upscales it to your screen. Lower is faster but softer.
clarityshader.config.fsr_sharpness.toolt: Strength of FSR's sharpening (RCAS) after upscaling.
clarityshader.config.fsr_enabled.tooltip: Turn FSR 1 upscaling on or off. When off, every profile renders at native resolution and the render scales below are ignored.
clarityshader.config.dynamic_lights.tool: Torches, lanterns, glowstone and other light sources light up their surroundings with smooth, coloured light: held by players and mobs, lying on the ground or placed in the world. Glowing mobs light the world too, as bright as they glow: the Warden's heartbeat, a creeper about to explode, Enderman eyes, Blazes, glow squids, fireballs and more.
clarityshader.config.reset_look.tooltip: Put every slider on this page back to its default value.
clarityshader.config.reset_look.confirm: Put exposure, saturation, contrast, warmth, atmosphere, water reflectivity and vignette back to their defaults?
clarityshader.config.ray_tracing.tooltip: Traces rays through the blocks around you: glossy reflections on obsidian, metal, glass, ice and polished stone, and lava, glowstone and fire light up their surroundings in their own colour, also from off screen. Heavier than the other effects.
